en.title: g-Pico Automation – About
en.sub-title: Free your hands, ignite your passion, and enjoy life!
en.description:
g-Pico Automation aims to make automation accessible and affordable for everyone—from individual makers, schools, and labs to small businesses.

We focus on:
• Measurement & control platforms based on Raspberry Pi Pico
• Automated testing, report generation, and data analysis
• Integrated hardware, firmware, and software total solutions with desktop GUIs

Our goal is to let machines handle repetitive tasks, so people can focus on meaningful design, creativity, and enjoying life.
